entities.name: Ribosomal protein uS8
observations: The 132-residue query sequence exactly matches curated UniProt reference Q1LTC4 at 100% identity and 100% coverage.
uS8 is a primary 16S rRNA-binding protein of the bacterial 30S ribosomal subunit and helps coordinate assembly of the platform.
Pfam identifies Ribosomal_S8 (PF00410.25) across positions 5–131 with i-Evalue 5.9e-46.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular weight 14,761.493 Da, theoretical pI 10.19, charge at pH 7 approximately +12.67, GRAVY -0.0758.
No explicit catalytic reaction or cofactor annotation was retrieved; the protein is best characterized as a nonenzymatic ribosomal structural/RNA-binding protein.
GO annotations from curated homologs: cytoplasm, ribosome, rRNA binding, structural constituent of ribosome, and translation.

entities.name: Bacterial 30S ribosome
observations: uS8 is a structural component of the small ribosomal subunit involved in bacterial translation and 16S rRNA organization.
